blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解品質系統如何應用於交叉污染風險管理，並與 ICH Q10 生命週期方法整合
blocks.en: Understand how the quality system applies to cross-contamination risk management and integrates with the ICH Q10 lifecycle approach

blocks.zh: 掌握 Logic Diagram（邏輯圖）的結構與決策流程——GMP/法規邏輯 vs. 工業衛生邏輯
blocks.en: Master the structure and decision flow of the Logic Diagram: GMP/regulatory logic vs. industrial hygiene logic

blocks.zh: 分析各 GMP 因素（清潔、混淆預防、機械性轉移、空氣傳播）對共用設施可行性的影響
blocks.en: Analyze how each GMP factor (cleaning, mix-up prevention, mechanical transfer, airborne transfer) affects the feasibility of shared facilities

blocks.zh: 評估健康/衛生因素（曝露評估、工程控制、PPE）對人員保護策略的重要性
blocks.en: Evaluate the importance of health/hygiene factors (exposure assessment, engineering controls, PPE) for personnel protection strategies

blocks.zh: 了解控制策略結果（專用設施 vs. 活動式製造 vs. 同期製造）對 CDMO 業務決策的意義
blocks.en: Understand what the control strategy outcomes (dedicated facility vs. campaign manufacturing vs. concurrent manufacturing) mean for CDMO business decisions

blocks.en: 3.1 Application to Cross-Contamination 3.1.1 Recommended Quality Policy 3.2 Logic Diagram 3.2.1 GMP/Regulatory Factors 3.2.2 Health and Hygiene Factors 3.2.3 Control Strategy Outcomes Logic Diagram Overview

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 — p21–p22 | 品質系統要求：整體框架
blocks.en: Chapter 3, pp. 21-22 | Quality System Requirements: Overall Framework

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 品質系統整體框架
blocks.en: Commentary: Overall Quality System Framework

blocks.zh: 核心概念：品質系統三層架構
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three-Tier Quality System Structure

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 要求品質系統涵蓋整個產品生命週期。在交叉污染管理情境下，文件層級由上而下：
blocks.en: ICH Q10 requires the quality system to cover the entire product lifecycle. In the context of cross-contamination management, the document hierarchy runs from the top down:

blocks.zh: 政策層（Policy）：高層次宣示，由高階管理階層核准
blocks.en: Policy level: a high-level statement approved by senior management

blocks.zh: 標準層（Standard）：技術性要求，如 ADE 決定程序
blocks.en: Standard level: technical requirements, such as the ADE determination procedure

blocks.zh: SOP 層：具體操作步驟（清潔、換產、風險評估）
blocks.en: SOP level: specific operating steps (cleaning, changeover, risk assessment)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：IH 與 GxP 雙軌評估
blocks.en: Key Point: Dual-Track IH and GxP Assessment

blocks.zh: 同一危害物質須同時進行兩條評估軌道，且結果必須相互對照：
blocks.en: The same hazardous substance must be assessed on two tracks at the same time, and the results must be cross-checked against each other:

blocks.zh: GxP 角度：保護病人，使用 ADE（可接受日曝露量）
blocks.en: GxP perspective: protects the patient, using the ADE (acceptable daily exposure)

blocks.zh: IH 角度：保護操作人員，使用 OEL（職業曝露限值）
blocks.en: IH perspective: protects the operator, using the OEL (occupational exposure limit)

blocks.zh: 若 IH 決策（如工程控制）影響 GxP 表現（如清潔可及性），必須重新評估。
blocks.en: If an IH decision (such as an engineering control) affects GxP performance (such as cleaning accessibility), the assessment must be redone.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：品質系統如同城市法規
blocks.en: Analogy: The Quality System as a City's Rules

blocks.zh: 品質政策是憲法，標準是法律，SOP 是施工規範。三者缺一不可——憲法確立原則，法律設定邊界，施工規範確保每天的執行一致性。
blocks.en: The quality policy is the constitution, standards are the laws, and SOPs are the construction codes. All three are indispensable: the constitution establishes the principles, the laws set the boundaries, and the construction codes ensure consistent execution every day.

blocks.zh: p22–p23 | 建議的六大品質系統領域
blocks.en: p. 22-23 | Six Recommended Quality System Areas

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 六大品質系統領域
blocks.en: Commentary: The Six Quality System Areas

blocks.zh: 系統性管理框架：六個交叉點
blocks.en: A Systematic Management Framework: Six Intersections

blocks.zh: ISPE Vol.7 識別出六個與交叉污染風險管理交織的品質系統，每一個都是潛在控制點或失效點：
blocks.en: ISPE Vol. 7 identifies six quality systems that intersect with cross-contamination risk management, each of which is a potential control point or point of failure:

blocks.zh: CDMO 業務重點：技術轉移觸發點
blocks.en: CDMO Business Focus: Technology Transfer Triggers

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，新產品引入（NPI）是最高風險時刻。ISPE 要求在化合物進入廠區之前就完成：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, new product introduction (NPI) is the highest-risk moment. ISPE requires that the following be completed before the compound enters the site:

blocks.zh: ADE 單體分析（毒理評估）
blocks.en: ADE monograph analysis (toxicological assessment)

blocks.zh: 清潔開發或歷史數據風險評估
blocks.en: Cleaning development or historical-data risk assessment

blocks.zh: 分析方法靈敏度確認
blocks.en: Confirmation of analytical method sensitivity

blocks.zh: 這個觸發機制應嵌入合約審查流程（Business Development → Quality → Engineering）。
blocks.en: This trigger mechanism should be built into the contract review process (Business Development, then Quality, then Engineering).

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Change Control CC 觸發清單
blocks.en: Practical Application: Change Control Cross-Contamination Trigger List

blocks.zh: 以下任一變更應自動觸發 CC 風險重新評估：
blocks.en: Any of the following changes should automatically trigger a cross-contamination risk reassessment:

blocks.zh: 新產品或化合物引入
blocks.en: Introduction of a new product or compound

blocks.zh: ADE 值更新或最大日劑量變更
blocks.en: Update of the ADE value or change of the maximum daily dose

blocks.zh: 設備設計或材質變更
blocks.en: Change of equipment design or materials

blocks.zh: HVAC 配置或水系統壓力/品質變更
blocks.en: Change of HVAC configuration or water system pressure/quality

blocks.zh: 製程規模放大或配方變更
blocks.en: Process scale-up or formulation change

blocks.zh: 清潔程序或清潔劑變更
blocks.en: Change of cleaning procedure or cleaning agent

blocks.zh: 比喻：變更控制是「CC 的早期預警系統」
blocks.en: Analogy: Change Control as the "Early Warning System for Cross-Contamination"

blocks.zh: 如同航空器維修系統——任何結構修改都會自動觸發安全審查，不需要靠人員記憶或手動觸發。CC 風險評估觸發應內建於 Change Control 流程，而非事後補做。
blocks.en: Like an aircraft maintenance system, where any structural modification automatically triggers a safety review without relying on people's memory or manual initiation. The cross-contamination risk assessment trigger should be built into the change control process rather than added after the fact.

blocks.zh: p23 | 邏輯圖：決策框架總覽
blocks.en: p. 23 | Logic Diagram: Overview of the Decision Framework

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — Logic Diagram 的核心地位
blocks.en: Commentary: The Central Role of the Logic Diagram

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 是什麼？
blocks.en: What Is the Logic Diagram?

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 是一個結構化決策工具，透過一系列是/否問題，引導跨職能團隊判斷：
blocks.en: The Logic Diagram is a structured decision tool that uses a series of yes/no questions to guide a cross-functional team in determining:

blocks.zh: 某產品是否可在共用設施製造？
blocks.en: Can a given product be manufactured in a shared facility?

blocks.zh: 需要什麼程度的專用（dedication）？
blocks.en: What level of dedication is required?

blocks.zh: 現有控制措施是否足夠？
blocks.en: Are the existing controls sufficient?

blocks.zh: 結果有三種：共用設施可行 部分專用 完全專用設施
blocks.en: There are three possible outcomes: Shared facility feasible Partial dedication Fully dedicated facility

blocks.zh: 重點：業務決策 vs. CC 風險決策的區分
blocks.en: Key Point: Distinguishing Business Decisions from Cross-Contamination Risk Decisions

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別強調：若基於商業原因（客戶要求、市場隔離）選擇專用設施，必須在風險評估文件中明確標注這是業務決策，而非 CC 控制必要性。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically emphasizes that if a dedicated facility is chosen for commercial reasons (customer requirements, market segregation), the risk assessment document must state clearly that this is a business decision and not a cross-contamination control necessity.

blocks.zh: 這樣做可防止：業務決策被誤解為監管要求，也避免未來類似產品引入時設定錯誤先例。
blocks.en: This prevents a business decision from being misread as a regulatory requirement, and avoids setting a wrong precedent when similar products are introduced in the future.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：Logic Diagram 作為 BD 篩選工具
blocks.en: CDMO Application: The Logic Diagram as a BD Screening Tool

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，Logic Diagram 應成為新客戶/新品種業務審查的標準流程：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the Logic Diagram should become the standard process for business review of new customers and new products:

blocks.zh: BD 階段：初步 ADE 篩查，快速判斷是否可接受
blocks.en: BD stage: preliminary ADE screening to quickly judge whether the product is acceptable

blocks.zh: 技術評估階段：完整 Logic Diagram 評估，確定設施需求
blocks.en: Technical evaluation stage: full Logic Diagram assessment to determine facility requirements

blocks.zh: 報價階段：將專用設備或隔離成本反映於合約條款
blocks.en: Quotation stage: reflect the cost of dedicated equipment or segregation in the contract terms

blocks.zh: 比喻：機場安全通道決策樹
blocks.en: Analogy: The Airport Security Decision Tree

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 如同機場入境流程——每個問題節點過濾一層風險。大多數旅客（低風險化合物）順利通過；少數需要進一步檢查（部分專用）；極少數被攔截要求特殊處理（專用設施）。重要的是：流程對所有人一視同仁，依風險而非直覺決策。
blocks.en: The Logic Diagram works like airport entry procedures: each question node filters out one layer of risk. Most travelers (low-risk compounds) pass through smoothly; a few need further checks (partial dedication); very few are stopped for special handling (dedicated facility). What matters is that the process treats everyone the same and decides by risk rather than by intuition.

blocks.zh: p23–p29 | GMP 邏輯鏈：從法規要求到技術控制
blocks.en: pp. 23-29 | The GMP Logic Chain: From Regulatory Requirements to Technical Controls

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — GMP 因素決策鏈
blocks.en: Commentary: The GMP Factor Decision Chain

blocks.zh: 重點：法規強制要求的第一道關卡
blocks.en: Key Point: The First Gate Is Regulatory Prohibition

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 第一個問題直接問：是否有法規文字明確禁止共用製造？
blocks.en: The first question in the Logic Diagram asks directly: Is there regulatory text that explicitly prohibits shared manufacturing?

blocks.zh: 答案是「是」的情況極少但清晰：
blocks.en: The answer is "yes" only rarely, but when it is, it is clear-cut:

blocks.zh: Beta-lactam 抗生素（21 CFR 211.42 / EU GMP 附錄）
blocks.en: Beta-lactam antibiotics (21 CFR 211.42 / EU GMP annex)

blocks.zh: 某些生物製品（活病毒疫苗）
blocks.en: Certain biological products (live virus vaccines)

blocks.zh: 若答案為「是」→ 直接終止評估，必須專用設施。不需要進一步 ADE 計算。
blocks.en: If the answer is "yes", the assessment ends immediately and a dedicated facility is mandatory. No further ADE calculation is needed.

blocks.zh: 重點：無法確定 ADE = 無法共用製造
blocks.en: Key Point: No ADE Means No Shared Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 若化合物毒理數據不足以推導出 ADE（例如：早期臨床試驗化合物、毒理數據缺失），預設結論是需要專用設施。
blocks.en: If the toxicological data for a compound are insufficient to derive an ADE (for example, early clinical trial compounds or missing toxicology data), the default conclusion is that a dedicated facility is required.

blocks.zh: 這是 ISPE Vol.7 的關鍵邏輯：不是「沒有數據所以安全」，而是「沒有數據所以必須保守假設」。
blocks.en: This is the key logic of ISPE Vol. 7: it is not "no data, therefore safe" but "no data, therefore a conservative assumption must be made".

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Analytical Method 靈敏度要求
blocks.en: Practical Application: Analytical Method Sensitivity Requirements

blocks.zh: 分析方法必須在 ADE 計算所得清潔限值以下偵測到殘留。常見計算路徑：
blocks.en: The analytical method must be able to detect residues below the cleaning limit calculated from the ADE. The common calculation path is:

blocks.zh: ADE（mg/day）→ 計算最大殘留限值（MRL, μg/cm²）
blocks.en: ADE (mg/day) → calculate the maximum residue limit (MRL, µg/cm²)

blocks.zh: LOQ 必須 ≤ MRL（通常要求 LOQ ≤ 50% MRL）
blocks.en: LOQ must be ≤ MRL (typically LOQ ≤ 50% of MRL is required)

blocks.zh: 若無法開發符合要求的方法 → 考慮部分或完全專用
blocks.en: If a method meeting the requirement cannot be developed → consider partial or full dedication

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 清潔 / 混淆 / 機械/空氣傳播控制
blocks.en: Commentary: Controls for Cleaning, Mix-Up, and Mechanical/Airborne Transfer

blocks.zh: 重點：清潔評估的四個維度（病人優先）
blocks.en: Key Point: Four Dimensions of Cleaning Assessment (Patient First)

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：成本和可行性考量不能凌駕於病人安全之上。評估順序：
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly that cost and feasibility considerations must not override patient safety. The order of evaluation is:

blocks.zh: 可行性：分析方法能達到所需偵測限嗎？
blocks.en: Feasibility: can the analytical method reach the required detection limit?

blocks.zh: 可操作性：自動化 vs. 手動清潔的一致性
blocks.en: Operability: consistency of automated vs. manual cleaning

blocks.zh: 成本：週期性（年度 vs. 週次）清潔的經濟性
blocks.en: Cost: economics of periodic cleaning (annual vs. weekly)

blocks.zh: 病人安全：最終判斷標準，不可妥協
blocks.en: Patient safety: the final criterion, which cannot be compromised

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：CMO 特殊考量
blocks.en: CDMO Application: Special Considerations for CMOs

blocks.zh: ISPE 3.2.1.12 特別點名 CMO 情境：
blocks.en: ISPE 3.2.1.12 specifically calls out the CMO situation:

blocks.zh: 操作標準必須足以處理委託產品
blocks.en: Operating standards must be adequate to handle the contracted products

blocks.zh: 若依賴工程控制，換產時的隔離切換程序需特別評估
blocks.en: If relying on engineering controls, the segregation changeover procedure at product changeover needs special evaluation

blocks.zh: 員工是否需要化合物特定專業培訓？
blocks.en: Do staff need compound-specific specialist training?

blocks.zh: 維修人員的交叉污染風險是否被納入評估？
blocks.en: Is the cross-contamination risk from maintenance personnel included in the assessment?

blocks.zh: 這些問題在與新客戶簽訂技術協議時應逐一確認。
blocks.en: These questions should be confirmed one by one when signing a technical agreement with a new customer.

blocks.zh: 比喻：部分專用如同共用廚房分區
blocks.en: Analogy: Partial Dedication Is Like Zoning a Shared Kitchen

blocks.zh: 高級餐廳的廚房可能設有獨立的過敏原料理區（專用砧板、刀具），但使用共用烤箱。這就是「部分專用」的精神——針對風險點精準隔離，而非整個廚房廢止共用。ISPE 3.2.1.18 的三個選項（專用套房、專用設備、拋棄式設備）正是這種梯度思維的體現。
blocks.en: A high-end restaurant kitchen may have a separate allergen preparation area (dedicated cutting boards and knives) but use a shared oven. This is the spirit of "partial dedication": isolate precisely at the risk points rather than abolishing sharing across the whole kitchen. The three options in ISPE 3.2.1.18 (dedicated suite, dedicated equipment, disposable equipment) embody this graduated thinking.

blocks.zh: GMP/Regulatory Logic (Left) + Health & Hygiene Logic (Right) | 決策邏輯圖全覽
blocks.en: GMP/Regulatory Logic (Left) + Health & Hygiene Logic (Right) | Overview of the Decision Logic Diagram

blocks.zh: p30–p33 | 工業衛生邏輯：人員曝露評估與控制
blocks.en: pp. 30-33 | Industrial Hygiene Logic: Personnel Exposure Assessment and Control

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — IH 曝露評估與控制層級
blocks.en: Commentary: IH Exposure Assessment and the Hierarchy of Controls

blocks.zh: 工業衛生 (IH) 控制層級（Controls Hierarchy）
blocks.en: Industrial Hygiene (IH) Hierarchy of Controls

blocks.zh: ISPE 遵循傳統工業衛生的控制優先順序：
blocks.en: ISPE follows the traditional industrial hygiene order of control priority:

blocks.zh: 消除 / 替代（最佳）：改變製程以消除曝露源
blocks.en: Elimination / substitution (best): change the process to remove the source of exposure

blocks.zh: 工程控制：密閉系統、通風、隔離屏障
blocks.en: Engineering controls: closed systems, ventilation, isolation barriers

blocks.zh: 行政控制：SOP、訓練、工作輪班
blocks.en: Administrative controls: SOPs, training, work shifts

blocks.zh: 個人防護設備 PPE（最後手段）：口罩、手套、防護服
blocks.en: Personal protective equipment (PPE) (last resort): masks, gloves, protective clothing

blocks.zh: PPE 應視為補充工程控制的手段，不應作為主要防護措施。
blocks.en: PPE should be regarded as a means of supplementing engineering controls and should not serve as the primary protective measure.

blocks.zh: 重點：OEL vs. ADE 的關鍵差異
blocks.en: Key Point: The Critical Difference Between OEL and ADE

blocks.zh: 即使來自相同毒理數據，OEL 和 ADE 的應用情境不同：
blocks.en: Even when derived from the same toxicological data, the OEL and ADE apply in different contexts:

blocks.zh: OEL：保護健康成年工人，以 8 小時吸入量為基礎（μg/m³）
blocks.en: OEL: protects healthy adult workers, based on an 8-hour inhaled exposure (µg/m³)

blocks.zh: ADE：保護病人（包括老人、兒童、免疫低下者），以每日口服或注射劑量為基礎（mg/day）
blocks.en: ADE: protects patients (including the elderly, children, and the immunocompromised), based on the daily oral or injected dose (mg/day)

blocks.zh: 因此同一化合物的 OEL 和 ADE 數值可能差異很大，應分別評估，不可相互替換。
blocks.en: As a result, the OEL and ADE values for the same compound can differ greatly; they should be assessed separately and must not be substituted for one another.

blocks.zh: 比喻：工程控制如安全氣囊，PPE 如安全帶
blocks.en: Analogy: Engineering Controls Are the Airbag, PPE Is the Seat Belt

blocks.zh: 安全氣囊（工程控制）是主動防護，設計上盡量讓乘客不需要靠它；安全帶（PPE）是被動防護，在主動防護失效時提供最後防線。兩者不可互相取代——PPE 的存在不能減少對工程控制的投資。
blocks.en: The airbag (engineering control) is active protection, designed so that passengers ideally never need to rely on it; the seat belt (PPE) is passive protection that provides the last line of defense when the active protection fails. Neither can replace the other: the existence of PPE does not reduce the need to invest in engineering controls.

blocks.zh: 緊急恢復計畫的三要素
blocks.en: Three Elements of an Emergency Recovery Plan

blocks.zh: 若主要圍堵系統失效，緊急應變計畫需包含：
blocks.en: If the primary containment system fails, the emergency response plan needs to cover:

blocks.zh: What：需要回收什麼？由誰執行？
blocks.en: What: what needs to be recovered, and who carries it out?

blocks.zh: How：需要什麼基礎設施（PPE 儲存、更衣區、淋浴間）？
blocks.en: How: what infrastructure is needed (PPE storage, gowning area, showers)?

blocks.zh: Air：是否需要獨立供氣系統服務防護 PPE？
blocks.en: Air: is a separate air supply system needed to serve the protective PPE?

blocks.zh: 緊急應變計畫應在產品引入前完成，而非在事故發生後才制定。
blocks.en: The emergency response plan should be completed before the product is introduced, not drawn up after an incident occurs.

blocks.zh: p33 | 控制策略的結果與回饋循環
blocks.en: p. 33 | Control Strategy Outcomes and the Feedback Loop

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 控制策略結果與 CDMO 業務意義
blocks.en: Commentary: Control Strategy Outcomes and Their Business Significance for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 三種決策結果的業務意涵
blocks.en: Business Implications of the Three Decision Outcomes

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 最終產出三種設施策略，每一種對 CDMO 的商業模式影響截然不同：
blocks.en: The Logic Diagram ultimately yields three facility strategies, each with a very different impact on the CDMO's business model:

blocks.zh: 重點：雙向回饋循環的重要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Importance of the Two-Way Feedback Loop

blocks.zh: Section 3.2.3 的核心訊息：IH 決策與 GMP 決策不能各自獨立最優化。
blocks.en: The core message of Section 3.2.3: IH decisions and GMP decisions cannot each be optimized independently.

blocks.zh: 典型衝突案例：
blocks.en: Typical conflict cases:

blocks.zh: IH 要求密閉隔離箱 → GMP 清潔人員無法進入 → 殘留風險上升
blocks.en: IH requires a closed isolator → GMP cleaning personnel cannot gain access → residue risk rises

blocks.zh: GMP 要求開放式清潔設計 → 操作員粉塵曝露增加 → OEL 超標
blocks.en: GMP requires an open, cleanable design → operator dust exposure increases → OEL exceeded

blocks.zh: IH 推薦一次性設備 → GMP 需要驗證拋棄性設備的殘留安全性
blocks.en: IH recommends single-use equipment → GMP needs to validate the residue safety of the disposable equipment

blocks.zh: 解決方案：跨職能評估，工程 + QA + IH 同時參與設計審查。
blocks.en: Solution: a cross-functional assessment, with Engineering, QA, and IH participating together in the design review.

blocks.zh: CDMO 業務決策流程建議
blocks.en: Recommended CDMO Business Decision Process

blocks.zh: 將 Logic Diagram 整合到新產品引入（NPI）的業務流程：
blocks.en: Integrate the Logic Diagram into the business process for new product introduction (NPI):

blocks.zh: BD 接洽時：索取化合物 ADE 或毒理概要，初步判斷可接受性
blocks.en: At BD engagement: request the compound's ADE or toxicology summary and make a preliminary judgment of acceptability

blocks.zh: 技術可行性評估：完整執行 Logic Diagram，確定設施策略
blocks.en: Technical feasibility assessment: run the full Logic Diagram and determine the facility strategy

blocks.zh: 報價與合約：將專用設備成本、驗證費用、換產損失納入定價
blocks.en: Quotation and contract: include dedicated equipment costs, validation fees, and changeover losses in pricing

blocks.zh: 技術協議：明確記載是 CC 控制需求還是業務決策的專用設施
blocks.en: Technical agreement: state clearly whether a dedicated facility is a cross-contamination control requirement or a business decision

blocks.zh: 定期回顧：ADE 值更新或製程變更時重新執行評估
blocks.en: Periodic review: repeat the assessment when the ADE value is updated or the process changes

blocks.zh: 比喻：Logic Diagram 如建築許可審查
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic Diagram Is Like a Building Permit Review

blocks.zh: 在城市建設前，必須通過結構安全（GMP/病人安全）和消防規範（IH/人員安全）雙重審查。建商不能因為消防設施成本高就跳過——同樣地，CDMO 也不能因為 IH 控制成本高就忽略對製程的影響。兩個審查必須同時通過，且相互不矛盾。
blocks.en: Before a city building is constructed, it must pass a dual review of structural safety (GMP/patient safety) and fire code (IH/personnel safety). A developer cannot skip the fire protection facilities because they are expensive; likewise, a CDMO cannot ignore the impact on the process because IH controls are expensive. Both reviews must be passed at the same time, without contradicting each other.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 章節總結與核心洞察
blocks.en: Commentary: Chapter Summary and Key Insights

blocks.zh: Chapter 3 四大核心洞察
blocks.en: Four Key Insights from Chapter 3

blocks.zh: 品質系統是 CC 管理的骨架：技術轉移、變更控制、風險管理、CAPA 必須相互連結，形成完整的 CC 管控網絡。
blocks.en: The quality system is the backbone of cross-contamination management: technology transfer, change control, risk management, and CAPA must be linked together to form a complete cross-contamination control network.

blocks.zh: Logic Diagram 是客觀決策工具：跨職能團隊使用，防止主觀判斷和情緒性決策（如「這個化合物聽起來很危險所以一定要專用設施」）。
blocks.en: The Logic Diagram is an objective decision tool: used by a cross-functional team, it prevents subjective judgment and emotional decisions (such as "this compound sounds dangerous, so it must have a dedicated facility").

blocks.zh: ADE 是 GMP 邏輯的核心數值：無法確定 ADE = 無法科學評估風險 = 必須最保守假設（專用設施）。
blocks.en: The ADE is the core value in GMP logic: no ADE means no scientific risk assessment, which means the most conservative assumption (dedicated facility) must be made.

blocks.zh: IH 與 GMP 必須雙向協調：兩者互為約束，任何控制策略必須同時滿足病人保護和人員安全，且不互相妥協。
blocks.en: IH and GMP must be coordinated in both directions: each constrains the other, and any control strategy must satisfy both patient protection and personnel safety without compromising either.

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵外帶訊息
blocks.en: Key Takeaways for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 的 Operations Director 而言，ISPE Vol.7 Chapter 3 提供了一個可防禦的、科學化的產品接受決策框架。
blocks.en: For a CDMO Operations Director, ISPE Vol. 7 Chapter 3 provides a defensible, science-based framework for product acceptance decisions.

blocks.zh: 當客戶或稽查員質疑「為什麼這個化合物能在共用廠房製造？」，完整記錄的 Logic Diagram 評估結果就是最有力的答案——不是直覺，不是歷史慣例，而是系統化的風險評估文件。
blocks.en: When a customer or inspector asks, "Why can this compound be manufactured in a shared facility?", a fully documented Logic Diagram assessment is the strongest answer: not intuition, not historical habit, but a systematic risk assessment document.

blocks.zh: 這也是 ISPE Vol.7 相較於一般 GMP 指引最獨特的貢獻：它給了製造業者一個說「Yes，我們可以共用製造」的科學依據，而不僅僅是告訴你何時需要說「No」。
blocks.en: This is also the most distinctive contribution of ISPE Vol. 7 compared with general GMP guidance: it gives manufacturers a scientific basis for saying "Yes, we can manufacture in a shared facility", rather than only telling you when to say "No".
